subject.title: fix(agents): reject invalid bundled LSP framing

question: Should bundled LSP sessions enforce the proposed 8 KiB header and 64 MiB body limits as fatal compatibility boundaries?
rationale: The source proves bounds are needed, but neither the LSP specification nor representative-server evidence defines these exact maxima, and exceeding either limit stops all tools backed by that server.

options.title: Adopt the proposed bounds
options.body: Keep 8 KiB and 64 MiB, document them as intentional bundled-LSP safety limits, and land after the malformed-header defect is fixed.

options.title: Choose different bounds
options.body: Set maintainer-approved thresholds based on representative server output and update tests and proof accordingly.

options.title: Pause fixed body limits
options.body: Land only strict syntax and incomplete-header protection while designing a separately reviewed bounded-body policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proposed bounds
recommendation.body: Keep 8 KiB and 64 MiB, document them as intentional bundled-LSP safety limits, and land after the malformed-header defect is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the bundled LSP runtime and is the strongest feature-history owner for its framing contract.
